notes.title: Technical Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for your feedback and suggestions. We pushed out an update last night that solved a couple issues, and implemented some enhancements.

Fixes

    Now when you hit Play, the game launches immediately and doesn't ask you to install the game every time.
    The game tracks time correctly when you launch it from Steam. If you've installed the game onto your desktop from the old installer, we recommend uninstalling that version. 

Enhancements

    The game now launches in full screen mode. This hides the border window around the game and makes it more immersive. 
    We've added a Quit button to the main menu. You have to navigate to it with the arrow keys and press space bar. 

Best Regards, 
- Sam n' Xan
